title: Shadowing in Dynamical Systems: Zero-dimensional Extensions and Inverse Limits
summary: Shifts of finite type (SFTs) play a central role in the theory of shadowing. Good and Meddaugh showed that SFTs serve as basic building blocks in the structural theory of shadowing systems; in particular, every compact metric dynamical system with shadowing is a factor of the inverse limit of an inverse sequence consisting of SFTs. We first show that, for this factor representation alone, neither shadowing nor metrizability is needed: every compact Hausdorff dynamical system is a factor of the inverse limit of an inverse system consisting of SFTs.
